At any rate it is now printed exactly as it was delivered, his perfectly clear manuscript being carefully followed.

arxiv-2207-08967.title: Tecnología Portátil de Pantalla Táctil de Bajo Costo, Aplicada a la Docencia Universitaria Thanks: Este artículo fue presentado en el Congreso de Electrónca e Informática 2010 de la Universidad Centroamericana “José Simeón Cañas” , celebrado el 25 y 26 de noviembre de 2010.

arxiv-2207-08967.description: Abstract En este artículo se describe una implementación de tecnología portatil de pantalla táctil de bajo costo, aplicada a la docencia universitaria, utilizando como base el control remoto de la consola Wii de Nintendo (conocido como Wiimote), un proyector de cañón normal, una computadora y software libre.

arxiv-2404-16778.title: Unifying Asynchronous Logics for Hyperproperties
arxiv-2404-16778.creator: Alberto Bombardelli, Laura Bozzelli, César Sánchez, Stefano Tonetta
arxiv-2404-16778.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alberto Bombardelli, Laura Bozzelli, César Sánchez, Stefano Tonetta. We introduce and investigate a powerful hyper logical framework in the linear-time setting that we call generalized HyperLTL with stuttering and contexts ( GHyperLTL S + C {}_{\textsf{S}+\textsf{C}} for short). GHyperLTL S + C {}_{\textsf{S}+\textsf{C}} unifies the asynchronous extensions of HyperLTL called HyperLTL S {}_{\textsf{S}} and HyperLTL C {}_{\textsf{C}} , and the well-known extension KLTL of LTL with knowledge modalities under both the synchronous and asynchronous perfect recall semantics.

arxiv-2406-03442.title: Are language models rational? The case of coherence norms and belief revision
arxiv-2406-03442.creator: Thomas Hofweber, Peter Hase, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal
arxiv-2406-03442.description: Abstract Do norms of rationality apply to machine learning models, in particular language models? In this paper we investigate this question by focusing on a special subset of rational norms: coherence norms. We consider both logical coherence norms as well as coherence norms tied to the strength of belief.

arxiv-2504-18423.title: LLMpatronous: Harnessing the Power of LLMs For Vulnerability Detection PubID: pubid: https://github.com/Rajesh9998/LLMPatronus
arxiv-2504-18423.creator: Rajesh Yarra
arxiv-2504-18423.description: Abstract Despite the transformative impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across various sectors, cyber security continues to rely on traditional static and dynamic analysis tools, hampered by high false positive rates and superficial code comprehension. While generative AI offers promising automation capabilities for software development, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for vulnerability detection presents unique challenges.

arxiv-2510-05286.title: Computing frustration and near-monotonicity in deep neural networks
arxiv-2510-05286.creator: Joel Wendin, Erik G. Larsson, Claudio Altafini
arxiv-2510-05286.description: Abstract For the signed graph associated to a deep neural network, one can compute the frustration level, i.e., test how close or distant the graph is to structural balance. For all the pretrained deep convolutional neural networks we consider, we find that the frustration is always less than expected from null models.

pmc-10542219.title: An agenda to develop Pediatric Palliative care programs to serve children with life-threatening and life-limiting conditions in the Gulf Cooperation Council countries
pmc-10542219.creator: Qutaibah Alotaibi, Harold Siden
pmc-10542219.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Medical advances have increased the number of children living with life-threatening/life-limiting illnesses worldwide, including in Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries. Pediatric palliative care (PPC) is a relatively young subspecialty that cares for children with life-threatening/life-limiting illnesses and their families. PPC aims to alleviate physical, psychological, and social distress in children with life-threatening/life-limiting illnesses and their families and improve their quality of life. PPC is an essential service that should be implemented in all nations, as it is a human right.

pmc-11392712.title: Commentary: Comparative Study of Indocyanine Green Intravenous Injection and the Inflation-Deflation Method for Assessing Resection Margins in Segmentectomy for Lung Cancer: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-11392712.creator: Chang Young Lee
pmc-11392712.description: See Article page 450. Recent findings from the JCOG0802 and CALGB alliance randomized control trials have demonstrated favorable short-term and long-term outcomes for segmentectomy in patients with peripheral, early-stage non-small cell lung cancer measuring 2 cm or less [1,2]. This evidence has increased interest in the procedure, which is considered technically more demanding than lobectomy.

pmc-11399689.title: Case report of HIV associated arthritis
pmc-11399689.creator: Govind Pandey, Kuldeep Singh, Tharuna Chandra
pmc-11399689.description: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection is prevalent worldwide. Children living with HIV/AIDS form a vulnerable subsection and may frequently present with clinical symptoms in the first year of life itself. Besides its well-known signs and symptoms, HIV infection can have a wide spectrum of musculoskeletal manifestations.

pmc-11452249.title: Skin Tone Analysis Through Skin Tone Map Generation With Optical Approach and Deep Learning
pmc-11452249.creator: Geunho Jung, Semin Kim, Sangwook Yoo
pmc-11452249.description: BackgroundSkin tone assessment is critical in both cosmetic and medical fields, yet traditional methods like the individual typology angle (ITA) have limitations, such as sensitivity to illuminants and insensitivity to skin redness.MethodsThis study introduces an automated image‐based method for skin tone mapping by applying optical approaches and deep learning.

pmc-11504177.title: Oral State and Salivary Cortisol in Multiple Sclerosis Patients
pmc-11504177.creator: Aleksandra Kapel-Reguła, Justyna Chojdak-Łukasiewicz, Anna Rybińska, Irena Duś-Ilnicka, Małgorzata Radwan-Oczko
pmc-11504177.description: Background: MS patients experience gradual and progressive functional limitation, bulbar symptoms, cognitive dysfunction, and psychiatric disorders that can impinge on oral status. This study aimed to investigate the oral state, oral hygiene habits, and salivary cortisol levels in patients with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) compared to healthy controls.

pmc-11581813.title: RSVpreF vaccination in pregnancy: a meta-analysis of maternal-fetal safety and infant efficacy
pmc-11581813.creator: Greg J Marchand, Ahmed Taher Massoud, Ahmed Taha Abdelsattar, Peter A McCullough
pmc-11581813.description: In May 2023, the United States Food and Drug Administration approved a Pfizer©-sponsored (Pfizer, New York, NY, USA) bivalent respiratory syncytial virus prefusion F protein-based vaccine (RSVpreF) RSV vaccine (AbrysvoTM [Pfizer]) for use during pregnancy to prevent neonatal/infant RSV infection.

pmc-11607630.title: The central role of creatine and polyamines in fetal growth restriction
pmc-11607630.creator: Eros Di Giorgio, Serena Xodo, Maria Orsaria, Laura Mariuzzi, Raffaella Picco, Vanessa Tolotto, Ylenia Cortolezzis, Francesca D'Este, Nicole Grandi, Lorenza Driul, Ambrogio Londero, Luigi E. Xodo
pmc-11607630.description: Placental insufficiency often correlates with fetal growth restriction (FGR), a condition that has both short‐ and long‐term effects on the health of the newborn. In our study, we analyzed placental tissue from infants with FGR and from infants classified as small for gestational age (SGA) or appropriate for gestational age (AGA), performing comprehensive analyses that included transcriptomics and metabolomics.

pmc-11674948.title: Genome-Wide Identification, Expression and Interaction Analysis of GLN Gene Family in Soybean
pmc-11674948.creator: Xin Hao, Yiyan Zhang, Hui Zhang, Gang Yang, Zhou Liu, Huiwei Lv, Xiaomei Zhou
pmc-11674948.description: As a globally significant economic crop, the seed size of soybean (Glycine max [L.] Merr.) is jointly regulated by internal genetic factors and external environmental signals. This study discovered that the GLN family proteins in soybean are similar to the KIX-PPD-MYC transcriptional repressor complex in Arabidopsis, potentially influencing seed size by regulating the expression of the downstream gene GIF1.

pmc-12492602.title: Efficacy and safety of treprostinil in pediatric pulmonary hypertension following fontan surgery: a real-world analysis
pmc-12492602.creator: Mingjie Zhang, Xi Chen, Yahe Xu, Yijun Chen, Zhiyue Zhang, Jingru Zhou, Zhuoming Xu
pmc-12492602.description: IntroductionThis study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of treprostinil in managing pulmonary hypertension (PH) following Fontan surgery in children. The hypothesis was that early postoperative administration of treprostinil could reduce pulmonary arterial pressure and improve oxygenation, utilizing real-life data to better reflect clinical practice.MethodsA single-center, retrospective study was conducted at the Shanghai Children’s Medical Center.

pmc-12567887.title: Improving the Suitability of Vaccine Design for Immunisation Programmes and Enhancing Vaccine Policy Quality Through User Research
pmc-12567887.creator: Stefano Malvolti, Melissa Malhame, Adam Soble, Carsten Mantel, Melissa Ko, Lorena Perrin, Tiziana Scarna, Marion Menozzi-Arnaud, Jean-Pierre Amorij
pmc-12567887.description: Background: The achievement of the goals of the Immunization Agenda 2030 (IA2030) requires vaccines to be developed and implemented that meet the needs and requirements of the final users: vaccinators and vaccinees. A detailed and shared understanding of these needs should inform policy and programme guidance directing stakeholders’ efforts and investments.

pmc-12654123.title: On Local Instability of Deep-Profiled Facings in Sandwich Panels
pmc-12654123.creator: Zbigniew Pozorski, Jolanta Pozorska, Zuzana Murčinková, Dawid Cekus
pmc-12654123.description: Highlights What are the main findings? The actual increase in load-bearing capacity was obtained for a facing bandwidth of less than 10 cm. What are the implications of the main finding? The critical stress in compression of a thin facing band resting on a flexible core was evaluated.

pmc-13084712.title: Development of an injectable thermosensitive hydrogel depot system for controlled and sustained subcutaneous drug delivery
pmc-13084712.creator: Quoc Lam Vu, I-Hui Chiu, Le Thuy Do, Thi Phuong-Quynh Nguyen, Thi Hai Nguyen, Dang Van Thanh, Muhammad Suhail, Pao-Chu Wu
pmc-13084712.description: Arthritis conditions are widely treated with oral nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, yet long-term therapy is often limited by gastrointestinal toxicity and variable systemic exposure. To overcome these issues, an injectable thermosensitive chitosan/β-cyclodextrin-graft-poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) hydrogel was developed as a subcutaneous depot for sustained diclofenac sodium delivery. The hydrogel was synthesized via free-radical polymerization using glutaraldehyde as a crosslinker.

pmc-13455202.title: M2 microglia-derived migrasome-enriched extracellular vesicles restore mitochondrial homeostasis to orchestrate neurovascular unit recovery after ischemic stroke
pmc-13455202.creator: Yuanjia Zhang, Jie Wu, Leyi Liu, Yiqian Zhu, Jierui Zhang, Jinghong Xu, Xuefeng Shi, Yu Yu, Chao Wang, Jiajing Xiao, Xuanchenye Zhang, Zhaorong Li, Wenqi Huang, Wenzhi Li, Zhongxing Wang, Tingting Li
pmc-13455202.description: Ischemic stroke is a major cause of disability with few treatment options available. Microglia-driven neuroinflammation contributes significantly to stroke pathology, and promoting anti-inflammatory microglial phenotypes represents a promising strategy. Migrasomes are newly discovered organelles mediating intercellular communication, yet their role in ischemic stroke remains unexplored.

uslaw-usc-t18-s502.title: 18 U.S.C. § 502 — Postage and revenue stamps of foreign governments
uslaw-usc-t18-s502.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s502.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 25 (Counterfeiting And Forgery). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever forges, or counterfeits, or knowingly utters or uses any forged or counterfeit postage stamp or revenue stamp of any foreign government, shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than five years, or both.
